source: The plan's design (internal-task plan.md, 'Sample size and the smallest detectable difference'): 100 targets with 3 requests each and 120 no-skill requests per setup and rung, a design effect of 1.2, 80% power, two-sided 5% for differences and one-sided 2.5% for non-inferiority. Opened-the-right-skill discordance is the plan's 25%. Harm-bar discordance is #449's native against resolver-on per setup (docs/benchmarks/2026-11-08-skill-resolver, merged trials, cross-family labels) until the pilot replaces it: Pi on Opus takes the mean of the three measured Opus setups, particle-1 takes Sol's share on the same harness or, where Sol never ran, the largest non-QM Sol share (Codex). No-skill opens were 0 of about 60 pairs in every #449 setup.
